rubric_items.reason: Built on the existing DoctorRepo, DoctorService, both DoctorListRow types, DoctorsPage, WEEKDAYS and GET /api/doctors. No new endpoint, table or migration. Keeps the routes/services/repositories layering and the client-only web access.

S-1 to S-6 are each mapped to components. With the oneOf parse, every weekday filter AC now works: the EXISTS condition in the shared WHERE covers S-3 and S-6 AC3, and the set helper plus search params cover S-4.

weekday and items[].weekdays each give name, type, nullability, format and example. The 400 rule is exact: oneOf over "1".."7", with absent or empty meaning Any day. The CO-2 SQL and Map contract are concrete.

Every component cites module-map symbols, product lines or IDE answers. The parse choice is now backed by validate.ts#L56 and doctorService.ts#L42. A-03 to A-05 match ide-answers.md. Nothing is invented.
Explains with costs: EXISTS vs JOIN, a separate per-page weekdays query, the with_today coupling, 1..7 link coding, and oneOf vs Fields.int.
Clear story-to-component map and consistent ids. CO-8 is still filed under the web module although it also covers the api router.
